name: DigiTax | Invoice Phase 1 | Flow 0 | Mailbox Intake | v0.1.0

parameters.content:
# Flow 0: Mailbox Intake (v0.1.0)

Watches one Outlook mail folder, classifies which messages/attachments are
real invoices addressed to Unternehmen X, then routes each confirmed invoice
into the existing frozen Flow 1a (structured factur-X/XRechnung) or Flow 1b
(PDF/OCR) webhook -- exactly the same webhooks TCMS's own browser-triggered
routes call -- and finally ingests the resulting resultBundle into TCMS
through a dedicated service-to-service endpoint, since an email arriving on
its own has no browser session to authenticate with.

This instance is single-tenant (one mailbox, one real TCMS organization,
set via UNTERNEHMEN_X_TCMS_ORGANIZATION_ID) -- no per-company mailbox routing
logic exists here on purpose.

AI EXECUTION PROFILE, no silent default: both classification steps
(body-level "has invoice?" and per-attachment is_invoice/is_issued_to_company)
require UNTERNEHMEN_X_FLOW0_CLASSIFICATION_PROFILE to be explicitly
"local-default" (LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL/LOCAL_LLM_MODEL) or "cloud-gemini"
(Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential, selected in the n8n UI) -- an unset
or unrecognized value fails closed to "...Profile Not Configured" rather
than guessing. H1's original 2026-09-02 policy for this workflow was
local-AI-only, no exceptions, for privacy (real invoice content never
leaving the local machine); superseded 2026-09-09 by H1's decision that
Unternehmen X goes full cloud-gemini, grounded in a real capacity study
(a real capacity study (see the project decision log) -- real steady-state
volume is ~1000x under Gemini's free-tier daily quota) and consistent with
the same decision that already made Flow 1b's extraction lane cloud-first.
Unternehmen X's real .env sets cloud-gemini. local-default remains a real,
supported option -- e.g. for a future tenant that has not consented to a
3rd-party AI provider seeing its invoice content -- not a legacy leftover.
See the project decision log for the full record; do not change this
default again without a fresh H1 decision logged there.

Imported inactive: fill in the REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CREDENTIAL_ID Microsoft
Outlook credential and the REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_INVOICE_FOLDER folder
reference in the n8n UI, set LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL/LOCAL_LLM_MODEL/
LOCAL_PDF_RENDER_URL (same vars Flow 1b's local lane already uses) plus
the Flow 0 env vars documented in .env.example, select a real Google
Gemini (PaLM) API credential on the two "...via Cloud (Gemini)" nodes if
using cloud-gemini, and publish a real OrganizationBaseline for this
organization in TCMS (Flow 0 fails closed with no buyer master data to
send) before activating.

nodes.name: Get All Messages from one specific Mail-Folder
nodes.notes: Points at a dedicated test-invoice mail folder -- no subject-keyword pre-filter, since every message moved into this folder is already a real test invoice by construction; the two-stage classification gate downstream (local text classification, then per-attachment local vision classification, cloud-gemini as of 2026-09-09) still runs unchanged. Credential id and folder value are placeholders -- pick your own Microsoft Outlook credential and folder live in the n8n UI after importing (n8n-init re-imports this file on every container restart, which resets these to whatever this file says, so a real deployment will re-pick them after a restart regardless).

nodes.name: Check Flow 0 Classification Profile (Message)
nodes.notes: No default: UNTERNEHMEN_X_FLOW0_CLASSIFICATION_PROFILE must be explicitly "local-default" or "cloud-gemini" -- same fail-closed discipline as "Check AI Execution Profile Configured" downstream for Flow 1b. Unternehmen X's real .env sets cloud-gemini per H1's 2026-09-09 decision (the project decision log); local-default remains available for a future tenant that has not consented to a 3rd-party AI provider seeing its invoice content. Unset/typo'd values fall to the "extra" output, not silently to either provider.

nodes.name: Classify Message via Cloud (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Same Gemini credential pattern as Flow 1b's cloud lane -- select your own real credential in the n8n UI after importing. Only reached when UNTERNEHMEN_X_FLOW0_CLASSIFICATION_PROFILE=cloud-gemini. maxTries:5/waitBetweenTries:2000 (2026-09-09, real stress-test finding): a live 2-email test run had 1/2 items fail here with Gemini's real 503 "model currently experiencing high demand" transient-overload error -- the original maxTries:3 with no delay retried too fast to let a transient overload clear. Matches Flow 1b's existing maxTries:5 precedent, plus an explicit delay Flow 1b's node doesn't have but should probably also get if this recurs there. UPDATE same day, real 8-attachment live test: options.batching (batchSize:1/batchInterval:13000) added after a real 429 came back verbatim as "Quota exceeded ... limit: 5, model: gemini-3.6-flash" -- the actual free-tier cap is 5 requests/minute, not the ~15 RPM the earlier capacity study (a real capacity study (see the project decision log)) assumed and explicitly flagged as unverified. Retries alone cannot fix a real quota exhaustion (Google's own suggested wait was 44s, far past maxTries:5 at 2s apart) -- spacing calls out up front is the real fix. See decision-log.md.

nodes.name: Classify Message Locally
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions call against LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL -- same env var Flow 1b's local lane already uses. No credential by default (a local dev endpoint is typically unauthenticated); add an Authorization header sourced from an environment expression if yours needs one. No cloud fallback on failure -- routes to "Message Classification Unavailable (Local AI)" instead.

nodes.name: Excluding mail which is not invoice for company
Claim Message (move to Verarbeitet)
nodes.notes: SERIAL GATE, not a side branch -- confirmed live 2026-09-04 that a parallel/dead-end version of this node does NOT prevent duplicate TCMS ingestion: when a manual run overlaps a scheduled run, both fetch and fully process the same message (both reach "Ingest Result to TCMS"), and only the SECOND one's mailbox move 404s -- the duplicate submission itself still goes through. Making this a real gate (its success output is the only path to "Split Attachments"/"Extract Email Metadata") means whichever execution loses the race (message already moved by the other) stops HERE and never reaches Flow 1a/1b submission at all -- exactly one execution processes each message. `onError: continueErrorOutput` routes a 404 (someone else already claimed it) to the dedicated error branch below instead of failing the whole execution. Deliberately placed after "Download Attachments" rather than right after "Get All Messages": Exchange/Graph message ids are not stable across a folder move, and "Download Attachments" needs the pre-move id -- moving earlier broke it with a live 404 ErrorItemNotFound (confirmed 2026-09-04). The move operation's own success output is just `{success: true}` (not the message's properties, and NOT its binary attachments) -- "Recover Message + Attachments After Claim" restores both from "Download Attachments" via itemMatching.

nodes.name: Message Already Claimed (Race Lost)
nodes.notes: This execution lost the race: another overlapping Flow 0 run (scheduled or manual) already claimed/moved this exact message first, so "Claim Message" 404'd. Intentional, quiet dead-end -- the OTHER execution is the one actually processing this invoice, so stopping here (not retrying, not erroring the whole workflow) is correct.

nodes.name: Extract Email Metadata for new invoice
Merge Attachment + Message Metadata by messageId
Route by Attachment Type
nodes.notes: PDF -> rendered to PNG first (most local vision endpoints reject a raw PDF as image_url, per Flow 1b's own local lane). image/* -> classified directly. Anything else (docx, xml, unknown) -> "Attachment Not Classifiable (Local AI)", never guessed at.

nodes.name: Render PDF Page as PNG (Local)
nodes.notes: Same dev-only render helper Flow 1b's local lane uses (examples/n8n/scripts/pdf_render_service.py), resolved purely from LOCAL_PDF_RENDER_URL. Not bundled or auto-started; must already be running. Response is expected to carry pngBase64, same contract as Flow 1b's own render call.

nodes.name: Check Flow 0 Classification Profile (Attachment)
nodes.notes: Same explicit, fail-closed gate as the message-level check -- no silent default. Unternehmen X's real .env sets cloud-gemini per H1's 2026-09-09 decision (the project decision log); local-default remains available for a future tenant that has not consented to a 3rd-party AI provider. Unset/typo'd values fall to the "extra" output, not silently to either provider.

nodes.name: Classify Attachment via Cloud (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Same Gemini credential pattern as Flow 1b's cloud lane -- select your own real credential in the n8n UI after importing. Only reached when UNTERNEHMEN_X_FLOW0_CLASSIFICATION_PROFILE=cloud-gemini. Gemini accepts the image inline (inline_data), unlike most local vision endpoints which reject PDF and often need a rendered PNG -- the render branch upstream still runs unconditionally for the local lane's benefit, and its PNG output is reused here rather than re-rendering.

nodes.name: Classify Attachment Locally
nodes.notes: Same LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL/LOCAL_LLM_MODEL as Flow 1b's local lane -- gemma-3-27b-it-qat is the proven-working vision model for this project (qwen/qwen3.8-27b is NOT vision-capable, per the root README). No cloud fallback on failure -- routes to "Attachment Not Classifiable (Local AI)" instead.

parameters.content:
## Mail intake and per-attachment invoice classification (local or cloud-gemini, explicit)
Body-level "has invoice?" classifier, then per-attachment is_invoice/
is_issued_to_company vision check -- each routes through a fail-closed
UNTERNEHMEN_X_FLOW0_CLASSIFICATION_PROFILE gate to either LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL/
LOCAL_LLM_MODEL or Gemini (2026-09-09 H1 decision: Unternehmen X's real .env
sets cloud-gemini, see decision-log.md). PDFs are rendered to PNG first for
the local lane via LOCAL_PDF_RENDER_URL, same as Flow 1b's own local lane;
the cloud lane sends the image inline to Gemini directly. Everything from
"Detect Invoice Format" onward is new: Flow 0's own job is routing and TCMS
ingestion, not re-running the legacy K1/K2/BZSt/Excel/Reqeli chain (out of
scope here).

nodes.name: Fetch Unternehmen X Buyer Master Data
nodes.notes: GETs this organization's real buyer master data (name/address/countryCode) and controlProfileId straight from its published TCMS OrganizationBaseline -- see server/api/organizations/[organizationId]/evidence/n8n-invoice-context/index.get.ts in tcms-framework. Fails closed (this branch) if no baseline has been published yet; Unternehmen X's real address is never hardcoded or duplicated into this workflow or into facturx_apis's own config.

nodes.name: Submit to Flow 1a
nodes.notes: Calls Flow 1a's own webhook (digitax-phase1-invoice-batch-item) directly, on this same n8n instance -- the identical webhook TCMS's own n8n-batch-item-runs route calls. Returns {resultBundle: ...} on success.

nodes.name: Ingest Result to TCMS (Structured)
nodes.notes: Server-to-server ingestion: no browser session exists for an email that arrived on its own -- see server/api/organizations/[organizationId]/evidence/n8n-inbound-runs/index.post.ts in tcms-framework.

nodes.name: Verify TCMS Ingestion Response (Structured)
nodes.notes: 2026-09-09, real live-test finding: a real 8-attachment run had one "Ingest Result to TCMS (OCR)" call return HTTP 200 with TCMS's login-page HTML instead of real JSON (likely the TCMS dev server hot-reloading at that exact moment) -- n8n's httpRequest node treats any 2xx as success regardless of body shape, so this silently counted as a success with no real database write. This gate makes the same check for the structured lane: a genuine ingestion response always has a numeric activityExecutionId; anything else (including a 200 with the wrong body) now correctly routes to the failure branch instead of "End Workflow".

nodes.name: Check AI Execution Profile Configured
nodes.notes: No default: UNTERNEHMEN_X_AI_EXECUTION_PROFILE must be explicitly set to local-default or cloud-gemini before Flow 0 will run any PDF/OCR invoice through Flow 1b -- never silently defaulted to cloud. Given H1's local-AI-only decision, set this to local-default in practice; cloud-gemini remains selectable here only because Flow 1b itself still treats it as a legitimate, explicit choice for OTHER callers (e.g. TCMS's own browser-triggered upload) -- Flow 0 should not select it for real Unternehmen X mail.

nodes.name: Submit to Flow 1b
nodes.notes: Calls Flow 1b's own webhook (digitax-phase1-flow1b-pdf-upload) directly, on this same n8n instance -- the identical webhook TCMS's own n8n-flow1b-runs route calls. The multipart file field must be named "data" (matches Flow 1b's own OCR chain, not "invoiceFile" like Flow 1a). Returns {resultBundle: ...} on success (unified with Flow 1a's envelope since 2026-09-01). batchSize:1/batchInterval:13000 added 2026-09-09: each call here triggers a real Gemini extraction call inside Flow 1b when aiExecutionProfile=cloud-gemini, and a real live 8-attachment test found the true free-tier limit is 5 requests/minute (not the ~15 RPM the earlier capacity study assumed) -- without spacing, multiple invoices submitted back-to-back in one Flow 0 run burst past that limit. See decision-log.md.

nodes.name: Ingest Result to TCMS (OCR)
nodes.notes: Server-to-server ingestion: no browser session exists for an email that arrived on its own -- see server/api/organizations/[organizationId]/evidence/n8n-inbound-runs/index.post.ts in tcms-framework.

nodes.name: Verify TCMS Ingestion Response (OCR)
nodes.notes: 2026-09-09, real live-test finding: a real 8-attachment run had one of these calls return HTTP 200 with TCMS's login-page HTML instead of real JSON (likely the TCMS dev server hot-reloading at that exact moment) -- n8n's httpRequest node treats any 2xx as success regardless of body shape, so this silently counted as a success with no real database write (only 3 real DB rows existed against 4 apparent "successes"). A genuine ingestion response always has a numeric activityExecutionId; anything else (including a 200 with the wrong body) now correctly routes to the failure branch instead of "End Workflow".

parameters.content:
## Format detection, routing, submission, TCMS ingestion
New for Flow 0. Detects factur-X/XRechnung vs. PDF/unknown via the
existing /v1/invoices/inspect endpoint, fetches this organization's real
buyer master data from its own published TCMS OrganizationBaseline (never
hardcoded here), then calls Flow 1a's or Flow 1b's existing webhook
directly -- the exact same webhooks TCMS's own browser-triggered routes
call -- and finally POSTs the resulting resultBundle into TCMS's dedicated
service-to-service ingestion endpoint.
